info.title: Moka API
info.description: The moka binary: HTTP API, background loop, web app

put.summary:
Turns the bot on (creating its account and key and handing them to Anchorr),
changes its token or server, or turns it off.

get.summary:
Films and episodes that arrived since a moment, for the bot to catch up
after being offline and to sum up the week.
Users with a linked Discord account, for the bot to request in their name.

post.summary: Creates a key that acts as the signed-in admin.
Creates the first admin account and signs it in. Only works while no users exist.
Logs in to the client with these settings. Does not save.

get.summary: Fonts attached to the file, for styled subtitles.
One attached font file (`n` from the font list).

post.summary: Decides how this browser plays the file and, if needed, starts converting it.

put.summary: Saves the signed-in user's position in the film this file belongs to.

get.summary: Subtitle tracks inside the file and subtitle files next to it.
One subtitle track as WebVTT, or as ASS for styled tracks.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the stream starts, in seconds; WebVTT cues are moved to match.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `vtt` (default) or `ass` for styled tracks, sent with their styling.

delete.summary: Stops a remux/transcode session and deletes its files.

post.summary:
Adds every film-capable indexer from Prowlarr (torrent and Usenet), searched through
Prowlarr's own Torznab endpoints. Running it again updates them instead
of adding duplicates.
Checks an indexer's settings by asking for its capabilities. Does not save.
Starts scanning in the background; poll the GET for progress.

put.summary: Links the signed-in user's own Discord account, so the Discord bot requests in their name.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: Only my own requests. Users without request management only ever see their own.

post.summary:
Requests a film or a show. Creates the title if it is new; if someone already asked
for it, this adds the user to that title instead of failing.

put.summary: Saves catalog settings. A new key is checked against TMDB before it is stored.
Saves the Jellyfin connection after checking it answers with the given key.
Saves the library folder after checking the server can write to it.
Saves the audio formats accepted for music, best first.

Chooses how films are converted for playback. If the graphics card fails,
playback falls back to the processor.

Saves the Radarr connection after checking it answers. While enabled,
approved films go to Radarr instead of Moka's own search.

get.summary: Every episode of a show, by season and number, or every track of an album.

post.summary: Sends one release from the last search to the download client, even if it was rejected.

put.summary:
Follows or stops following an episode, or all episodes of a season.
Followed episodes that are wanted get searched.

post.summary:
Searches indexers for this film now and returns every release with its verdict.
Nothing is grabbed; use `grab` to pick one, or let the background search pick.

AlbumTrack.description: A track of an album, with the file to play when it is in the library.

discord_token.description: The Discord bot token. Needed the first time; omit to keep it.

guild_id.description: The Discord server to work in, when the bot is in several.

public_url.description: Moka's address for links in Discord; empty for none.

AnchorrView.description: The connection as the UI sees it. The bot token and key never come back.

oneOf.description: What Anchorr reports, when it answers.

error.description: Why Anchorr could not be asked, in plain words.

needs_setup.description: True until the first admin account exists.

oneOf.description: The audiobook, when it is in the library or requested.

author_olids.description: Open Library author ids, in the order of `authors`.

oneOf.description: The ebook, when it is in the library or requested.

BotStatus.description: What Anchorr reports about the bot.

announce_channel_set.description: Whether new titles have a channel to be announced in.

dashboard_url.description: Anchorr's own dashboard, for channels, roles and messages.

guild_id.description: The server the bot works in.

invite_url.description: Link that adds the bot to a Discord server with the rights it needs.

tmdb_key.description: New key. Omit to keep the current one; an empty string goes back to the built-in key.

CatalogSettingsView.description: Catalog settings as the UI sees them. The key itself is never returned.

tmdb_key_set.description: The admin set their own key; otherwise the built-in one is used.

ClientCaps.description: What the browser said it can decode (from `MediaSource.isTypeSupported`).

containers.description: Containers the browser plays as a plain file, e.g. ["mp4", "webm"]

max_height.description: Highest video height the device wants; larger is scaled down when transcoding.

key.description: Shown only now. Moka keeps just a hash of it.

discord_id.description: The Discord account's numeric id; empty to unlink.

password.description: Omit when editing to keep the stored password. For SABnzbd: the API key.

Encoder.description: Video encoder used when a film must be converted.

episodes.description: For a show: the episodes that arrived.

link.description: The title's page in Moka, when a public address is set.

HwAccel.description: Hardware video conversion, stored under the `playback` setting.

paused_until.description: Unix time until which the indexer is paused after errors.

api_key.description: Omit when editing to keep the stored key.
Omit to keep the stored key.

JellyfinView.description: Jellyfin connection as the UI sees it. The key is never returned.

audiobooks_path.description: Folder audiobooks are imported into. Empty until audiobooks are wanted.

books_path.description: Folder ebooks are imported into. Empty until ebooks are wanted.

movies_path.description: Folder films are imported into, as the server sees it.

music_path.description: Folder albums are imported into. Empty until music is wanted.

shows_path.description: Folder shows are imported into. Empty until shows are wanted.

LocalState.description: Where a catalog film stands locally, if it is known at all.

studio.description: A studio album or EP (not live, not a compilation).

qualities.description: Accepted format keys, in any order; they are ranked best first.

MusicProfileView.description: Which audio formats music downloads may have.

formats.description: Every format there is, best first.

kind.description:
`movie` (default), `show`, `album`, `ebook` or `audiobook`. A show is
requested whole, specials left out, unless `seasons` names some.

mbid.description: MusicBrainz album (release group) id, for albums.

olid.description: Open Library work id, for ebooks and audiobooks.

seasons.description: For a show: only these seasons. Seasons asked for earlier stay followed.

tmdb_id.description: TMDB id, for films and shows.

events.description: Any of: requested, approved, declined, grabbed, available, failed. Defaults to all.

burn_subtitle.description:
Image subtitle track to draw into the picture (`e<N>` from the
subtitle list). Forces conversion.

start_seconds.description: Where to start, in seconds from the beginning of the film.

reasons.description: Why the file is not played as is.

session.description: Session to stop when done (remux/transcode only).

start_seconds.description: The stream begins at this point of the film (0 for direct play).

url.description: Plain file for direct play, an HLS playlist otherwise.

bookmark.description:
For books: where the reader stopped (an EPUB location) or the
audiobook part playing. Left as it was when not sent.

skipped.description: Indexer name and why it was left out.

cutoff.description: Stop upgrading once a file of this quality (or better) exists.

size_limits.description: Per quality key, in MB per minute of runtime.

Quota.description: Per-user request limit, stored under the `requests.quota` setting.

limit.description: Maximum films per period. Missing or zero means unlimited.

api_key.description: Omit to keep the stored key.

RadarrView.description:
Radarr connection as the UI sees it, with Radarr's profiles and folders
to choose from once connected. The key is never returned.

error.description: Why Radarr could not be reached, when it could not.

ReleaseView.description: One release from the last search, with the verdict on it.

beats_next_by.description: Why it ranks above the next acceptable release.

index.description: Position in the last search; pass it to `grab`.

searched_at.description: Unix time of the search; null if never searched since start.

olid.description: Open Library id, for ebooks and audiobooks.

title_state.description: Lifecycle state of the film itself.

kind.description:
`movie` (default), `show` or `album`. Episodes of a new show that
aired but are not on disk are not searched; new episodes are. Albums
are read as `Artist/Album (Year)`; `ebook` and `audiobook` as
`Author/Title (Year)` or `Author/Title.epub`.

path.description: Folder to scan. Defaults to the library's films, shows or music folder.

unmatched.description: Names that could not be matched to a film, for the user to fix.

kind.description: movie | show | season | episode | artist | album | track | author | ebook | audiobook

monitored.description: Searched for automatically (specials are not, by default).

parent_id.description: Season of an episode, show of a season, artist of an album, author of a book.

release_date.description: First air date for shows and episodes.

state.description: requested | wanted | searching | grabbed | downloading | importing | available

state_reason.description: Plain-language reason for the current state, when there is one.

TitleEvent.description: What Anchorr receives when titles arrive, and what it reads back to catch up.

requester_user_ids.description: Users with an open request for the title, to tell them it is here.

id.description: `e<N>` for the N-th track inside the file, `x<N>` for the N-th file next to it.

language.description: ISO language code when known, e.g. `en`, `eng`, `rum`.

styled.description: Styled subtitles (ASS/SSA), which the player can show with their styling.

text.description:
False for image subtitles: they are drawn into the picture instead,
which needs converting the video.

discord_id.description: Links a Discord account (its numeric id); an empty string unlinks it.

password.description: Sets a new password and signs the user out of every device.

discord_id.description: Linked Discord account (numeric id), used by the Discord bot.

permissions.description: Bitmask: 1 admin, 2 manage requests, 4 request, 8 auto-approve, 16 manage library, 32 play.

url.description: Scheme and host only; the full address may contain a token.
